- public/audio/sfx_witch_*, sfx_zombie_*, sfx_bat_*, sfx_dracula_laugh, sfx_scared — "Goofy Sounds for Scary Monsters" (DSOP Asset Pack Jam 2022), Christopher Hahn (Stormyman) et al., https://stormyman.itch.io/goofy-sounds-for-scary-monsters, CC0 (LICENSE in the pack).

- public/audio/sfx_creak, sfx_door_open, sfx_door_slam, sfx_knife, sfx_page, sfx_pot — Kenney "RPG Audio", https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio, CC0.
